command: cd /code && Rscript -e 'load("/data/ratingData5"); ratingData5Aggr <- aggregate(likingRating ~ ParticipantNumber * USval * correspondingTime, ratingData5, mean); library(tidyr); ratingData5AggrW <- spread(ratingData5Aggr, USval, likingRating); ratingData5AggrW$EC <- ratingData5AggrW$positive - ratingData5AggrW$negative; ratingData5AggrW$pTime <- ifelse(as.character(ratingData5AggrW$correspondingTime) == "153", "30 ms", "1000 ms"); print(aggregate(EC ~ pTime, ratingData5AggrW, mean));'
